quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Expands Pluggable Optical Line Systems Portfolio (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The enhanced full C-band Pluggable Optical Line System (POLS) in a QSFP form factor 'is generally available and shipped in high volume', with 21dBm output power and versions for 400G and 800G ZR and ZR+ applications; it uses Coherent's dual-chip 700mW uncooled 3-pin 980nm pump laser.
quarterly_data.figure: generally available and shipped in high volume; 21dBm output power; 400G and 800G ZR/ZR+ versions
